column3: Close to the Hebrew; the refrain’s “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy” throughout the psalm.
Close to the Hebrew; בִּתְבוּנָה (“by understanding”) is rendered “by wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Sea of Reeds” is rendered “the Red Sea,” and “cut into pieces” “divided… in two.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְנִעֵר (“shook off”) is rendered “overthrew,” and “Sea of Reeds” “the Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַדִּירִים (“majestic”) is rendered “famous.”
